Subject: Quick hosted API eval — we'd like to try the sandbox

Hi Ben,

We signed up on the self-serve flow this morning and spun up a quick test — looks promising. We're a small ML infra team at Threadline Labs and want to validate latency and embedding quality for a 2–3 model baseline before committing to dedicated capacity.

Would you have 30 minutes this week to walk us through the Hosted API sandbox, rate-limit guidance, and a brief tips/tricks on batching? We're PST-based (Palo Alto) and mornings are easiest for us.

Alyssa Turner
Director of ML Infrastructure
Threadline Labs
alyssa@threadlinelabs.com
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0118

P.S. I attached a short doc with our test plan and a sample prompt set (hosted-api-quickstart.pdf).

- Tue 8/21, 9:00–9:30am
- Tue 8/21, 11:30–12:00pm
- Wed 8/22, 8:30–9:00am

If none of those fit, share a couple times that do and I'll adjust. I added Marissa (SDR) to cc — she'll provision a sandbox token and send sandbox access notes ahead of the meeting.

2) 10m live Hosted API quickstart (latency profile, token accounting)

4) 5m next steps / sandbox test plan
